case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
title: Long Venue Address Preserved Exactly
tests: Checks that a long address survives rendering without abbreviation, dropped components, altered punctuation or illegibly small type.

exact_text.text: Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB
exact_text.read_as: Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John

faults.what: The address stops at "St. John", omitting the apostrophe and s, Road, Kingston upon Thames, the postcode, and the remaining commas.
The gray panel, bright lettering, and rusty-brown distressed borders depart from the requested clean black-and-cream design.

judge.summary: The portrait flyer has the correct date and time, but its headline is incomplete and a substantial portion of the required address is missing.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly "Printmakers' Open Studio".
The date and time read exactly '9 October 2027' and '11:00–17:00'.
must_haves.why: Both are visible and correctly rendered.

must_haves.item: The entire address appears in order: "Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB"; line breaks are permitted.
must_haves.why: The visible address ends at "St. John".

must_haves.item: The address preserves the en dash in '127–129', the period and apostrophe in "St. John's", and every comma.
must_haves.why: The apostrophe and the commas in the omitted remainder are absent.

must_haves.item: All address text is comfortably legible and inside the canvas, with no truncation or abbreviations.
must_haves.why: The visible text is large and readable, but the address is incomplete.

must_haves.item: The single portrait 4:5 flyer uses black and cream and contains no extra wording.
must_haves.why: It is a single portrait 4:5 flyer with no extra wording, but the dominant gray panel, light lettering, and rusty-brown borders do not meet the black-and-cream palette.
